notice: DEMO ONLY. Source-checked developer relevance labels, not company policy approval or an independent benchmark.

review.method: Read all 26 original supplied sections and freeze these labels before the first hybrid quality measurement.
review.selection: Technical anchors, paraphrases, schedules, shared guidance, multi-section relevance and no-evidence cases. No tuning against these questions.

cases.question: SUMIFS báo kích thước mảng khác nhau thì sửa thế nào?
cases.label: answerable
cases.rationale: All three sections directly discuss equal sum/criteria ranges.

cases.label: answerable

cases.label: answerable
